🏠 Menu

❤️ My likes

Your mate says one post with 200 likes means you are "basically famous".

Your last 5 posts got 120, 85, 200, 95 and 150 likes. What is the mean?

🤔 Guess first! Write it down.

Step 1

Add them all

120 + 85 + 200 + 95 + 150 = 650

Step 2

divide by 5 posts

650

5

= 130 likes

Mean 130 likes. Not famous yet! ❤️

⚽ Five-a-side wages

A team pays £300, £320, £350, £380 a week. The star gets £10 000.

The club says the "average" wage is £2270. Is that fair?

🤔 Guess first! Write it down.

Step 1

Mean =

11 350

5

£2270: only the star earns that

Step 2

Median: the middle

£350

The median £350 is fairer. One star wrecks the mean! ⚽

The 91 is an outlier.

Q1

Calculator

[5 marks]

Five students sit a test. The mean mark is 64. Later the teacher finds that one mark was written as 54 but it should have been 74. (a) Work out the correct total of the five marks. (b) Work out the correct mean. (c) By how much did the mean change?

Hint

Answer

Old total = 5 × 64.

Answer: (a) 340 (b) 68 (c) 4

click to solve →

Q2

Calculator

[6 marks]

Two machines each fill five bags with flour. The weights in kg are: Machine A: 2.1, 2.0, 1.9, 2.2, 2.0. Machine B: 2.3, 1.7, 2.0, 2.4, 1.6. (a) Calculate the mean weight for each machine. (b) Work out the range for each machine. (c) Which machine is more reliable? Give a reason.

Hint

Answer

A smaller range is more reliable.

Answer: Machine A (range 0.3 against 0.8)

click to solve →

Q3

Calculator

[6 marks]

The table shows the journey times of 20 students: 0 < t ≤ 10: 4, 10 < t ≤ 20: 8, 20 < t ≤ 30: 6, 30 < t ≤ 40: 2. (a) Work out an estimate of the mean time. (b) Explain why it is only an estimate.

Hint

Answer

Use the midpoints.

Answer: 18 minutes
